articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Crowned 2026's "Best-Selling Physical Video Game In The US"
articles.summary: "After just one week". The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 got off to an outstanding start, selling over five million copies (approx 5.2 million units) in just four days. Sales in the UK and Japan have contributed to this , and now, Circana Retail Tracking Service has shared data about the title's US launch.
